description: This source file defines the PersistentStateAttributeMapper class, which maps persistent state attributes to corresponding factory instances within the Orleans runtime environment. It implements methods to generate factories for persistent state objects, leveraging dependency injection and reflection.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: A class that maps persistent state attributes to factory instances for Orleans grains.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a factory for a persistent state object based on the provided attribute and method parameters.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory's create method via reflection to instantiate the persistent state object.
